title: Musk, Uber co-founder join call for Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia
summary: Tech tycoon Elon Musk and an Uber co-founder are, as of Sunday, among more than 158,000 signatories of an open letter calling for Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia chief.
